text: The report says its clinical–environmental comparison extends Hua et al.'s US isolate findings to 7,838 species with text-classified isolation sources.

text: The report interprets intrinsic AMR fitness neutrality as an exception to core_gene_tradeoffs findings that core genes are more burdensome overall, with core AMR appearing less costly than non-AMR core genes.

text: The 83K AMRFinderPlus hits are not all antibiotic resistance because the scope includes mercury and arsenic stress-response genes.

text: Only 28% of genomes have AlphaEarth embeddings, biased toward genomes with geographic metadata.
quote: **AlphaEarth coverage**: Only 28% of genomes have embeddings, biased toward genomes with geographic metadata
heading: Limitations

text: Only 37/48 Fitness Browser organisms had AMR genes, predominantly environmental strains, so the fitness analysis does not capture costs of recently acquired mobile resistance in pathogens.
quote: **Fitness Browser coverage**: Only 37/48 FB organisms had AMR genes, and these are predominantly environmental strains — the fitness analysis doesn't capture the cost of recently acquired mobile resistance in pathogens
heading: Limitations

text: Keyword-based mechanism classification leaves 22% as Other/Unclassified, and the report suggests CARD ontology as an improvement.
quote: **Mechanism classification**: The keyword-based mechanism classification leaves 22% as "Other/Unclassified" — a more systematic approach using CARD ontology would improve this
heading: Limitations

text: Some singleton AMR clusters may be annotation artifacts rather than true species-specific resistance genes.
quote: **Singleton inflation**: Some singleton AMR clusters may reflect annotation artifacts rather than true species-specific resistance genes
heading: Limitations

text: The report did not apply Bonferroni or FDR correction to the many tests under six hypotheses, arguing primary p-values were extreme (many < 1e-100) and correction would not change conclusions.
quote: **Multiple testing**: The six hypotheses involve many individual tests (per-mechanism binomial tests, per-phylum correlations, per-environment comparisons). Formal Bonferroni or FDR correction was not applied because the primary test p-values are extreme (many < 1e-100) and correction would not change any conclusion.
heading: Limitations

text: Per-gene and per-phylum tests are exploratory and should be treated as hypothesis-generating.
quote: The per-gene and per-phylum tests are exploratory and should be interpreted as hypothesis-generating
heading: Limitations

text: The conservative 100% DIAMOND identity threshold for Fitness Browser–pangenome linking may miss closely related alleles and undercount AMR fitness effects.
quote: **FB-pangenome identity threshold**: The 100% DIAMOND identity threshold for FB-pangenome linking is conservative; closely related allelic variants may be missed, potentially undercounting AMR gene fitness effects
heading: Limitations
